Arrow Rush Escape

Arrow Rush Escape

About Arrow Rush Escape

Arrow Rush Escape is a neon puzzle where every tap slides an arrow off the board. Free the arrows in the right order: if one is still blocked, it bumps and you lose a heart. Slide snakes, thaw frozen blocks, turn spinners and dodge bombs across 120 hand-tuned levels in 6 worlds, plus a fresh daily puzzle. Chain quick taps for combos, earn up to 3 stars per level, collect coins for hints and skins, and unlock new worlds with your stars. A drum-and-bass soundtrack builds as the board empties. Easy to learn, tricky to master.

How to play

Mouse or touch tap an arrow to slide it off the board Keyboard arrow keys move the cursor Enter or Space taps H for a hint R to restart M to mute
